reviewContext.userProblem: Performers need DJ-effect-style live control: right-drag (iPad: two-finger drag) on a bound number changes the live value without editing the document and returns to the base value on release (glide by default, Shift snaps). Stopping playback currently cuts everything abruptly (Mod-. sends hush); like ordinary synths, the default stop should let voices release and delay/reverb tails ring out, with an explicit instant cut also available by shortcut.
requiredOutcomes: Right-drag on a bound Direct numeric site sends momentary targets with left-drag scaling; the document text never changes; release glides back over the glide time (default 1000 ms, controls-pane setting, localStorage vactr.momentary.glideMs); Shift release snaps back; the overlay shows the live value.
Two-finger touch drag performs the same tweak; multiple simultaneous tweaks via independent pointer pairs; a re-evaluation during a tweak re-bases it.
Context menu suppressed only when a right press starts on a bound site.

Stop button and Mod-. send stop-all (gentle): every slot Natural release, effect tails ring out until master peak < -80 dBFS for 300 ms with 0 voices or a 15 s cap, then idle; restart during a tail works.
Hush button, Mod-Shift-. and the hush native cut: ~5 ms anti-click fade, effect state cleared in bounded chunks.
Glide and smoothing run as audio-clock cell ramps in dsp::Engine (browser worklet and native CPAL alike); no per-frame JS audio writes; no audio-thread allocation.
Deterministic Rust and vitest coverage plus silent Chromium/WebKit behavior e2e; all gates in LP-EVIDENCE exit 0; commit and non-force push to origin wf/live-perf.
nonGoals: Changing left-drag permanent edit behavior (writeSite, overlay or source edit).
Persisting momentary values or glide time in the document or session.
Momentary tweaks on Reeval or Manual tier sites.
Changing the production master output stage, MIDI/OSC sink stop behavior, or any existing gate or threshold.
constraints: English only, no emojis; Rust files under 1000 lines; rustfmt on touched files only.
Bounded messages and state: at most 16 momentary entries, 32 engine ramp slots, one OutputStop per user action, 16 ms per-entry drag rate.
UI uses flat square token-based styling (border-radius 0).
Automated tests are silent (silent sink, post-sink peak 0; headless native host); never change macOS volume.
Measurement lock for browser runs, test:style and the full nextest run; never two heavy suites at once.
Canvas editor performance gates must not regress.
Work only on wf/live-perf; non-force push to origin wf/live-perf; no main push, no PR.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1/D2: three stop scopes (slot, every slot via new session-side stop-all, whole output) and two modes; gentle is the default, cut is hush, so 'stop every slot' also covers slots the editor never saw.
D3: Release::Natural also releases scheduled voices with open gates, so gentle stop gives note-off envelopes instead of playing whole gates out.
D4: tail detection on the master output peak (-80 dBFS held 300 ms, 15 s cap) reported via TransportSample.output.
D5: song mode reuses Draining (arrangement end = now) for gentle and cutoff() for cut.
D6: glide time is an editor-local performer preference.
D7: the momentary tweak is a separate override layer that never writes the tweak slot, so migrate/persistence/commit never see it; Direct tier only.
D8: glide is an audio-clock ramp in the shared engine (CellRamps) with the session evaluating the same ramp for evaluator-side reads.
D9: effect state is zeroed in bounded chunks while the output gate is closed; nothing is reallocated.
D10: one app-level keydown handler matching event.code 'Period' owns both shortcuts; the code keymap Mod-. binding is removed.
D11: a chorded right press during a left drag starts no tweak.
intentionalTradeoffs: Momentary values reach audio at each consumer's existing read granularity (voice start for event controls, block start for continuous ones).
Desktop tweaks are sequential (one mouse pointer); concurrent tweaks need touch.
Admission from ClearingIdle resumes Running over partially cleared effect memory whose tail is already below -80 dBFS (inaudible).
Plans run as three waves with --max-concurrency 1 because they share target/, editor/node_modules/.vite and the tree-sitter wasm artifact.
LP-EVIDENCE archives (moves without editing) this manifest and all plans in the final serial closeout after every other plan has finished.
supportedEdgeCases: Release after a re-key resolves by current id or the one-step alias; release after edit invalidation; stale drags dropped silently; unknown-id release is a silent no-op.
Re-evaluation during a held or releasing tweak re-bases it; unmatched entries drop; hush clears all momentary entries with drop ramps.
Restart during a gentle-stop tail; cut during draining; Cut never downgraded by a later Gentle; OutputStop re-sent at most 3 times.
Shift turning '.' into '>' (event.code match); Meta on Mac/iPad and Ctrl elsewhere; key repeat ignored; shortcuts work with any focus.
Stepped or integer cells receive frames-0 steps only; frames-0 release drop; song gentle end and cut.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: A note already sounding does not follow a change to an event-level control.
MIDI and OSC sinks get no extra note-offs from gentle stop.
A cut issued while a song install is pending waits for the existing control-drain gate.
Physical iPad two-finger gesture check (synthetic browser multi-touch only; recorded pending).
